create_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms: create a random FCC crystal structure with a specified number of atoms and lattice constant
create_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells: create an FCC crystal supercell with a given number of unit cells along each axis
create_water_box: create a random box of water molecules with configurable count and box size

review_get_slab_adsorbate: review the get_slab_adsorbate function to understand OC20 tag conventions and FixAtoms usage
